span.p:
match:
PTAC→hvac_ptac · PTHP→hvac_pthp
RTU AC→hvac_packaged_rooftop_ac
RTU HP→hvac_packaged_rooftop_heat_pump
(supplemental_heating_fuel from HeatPumpBackupSystemFuel)
Pkg VAV HW reheat · VAV HW reheat
Warm air furnace · VRF · 4-pipe FCU

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
mapping_gap:
VAV electric reheat, WLHP, GSHP,
chilled beam, radiant

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
not_mappable:
split DX, split/mini/multi-split HP, SPVAC/SPVHP,
field-assembled DX, 2-pipe fan coil, baseboard/radiator,
heating-only or cooling-only pair, multizone CAV / CAV reheat,
VAV no reheat, unsupported VAV reheat, UFAD, evaporative,
steam/district/solar heat, absorption/district cooling,
air-cooled chiller

air cleaner, natural ventilation?
